title: Update-user endpoint, cache stats, docs pass, email fix, deps
description: Kitchen-sink PR with five interleaved concerns: PUT /users/:id (client, service, validation, tests), cache hit/miss stats, a JSDoc pass over several modules, a stricter email regex, and mechanical churn (generated routes, typescript bump, tsconfig reindent). One hunk in client.ts mixes a doc comment with the new put() method.
